title: Expo vs Bare Workflow in React Native

scenes.say: Ever wonder if you should start your React Native project with Expo or go bare? Let's break down when each makes sense.

scenes.label: Managed
scenes.sub: No native code needed. Fast setup.
scenes.say: Expo is a managed workflow. You skip the native setup and get building right away.

scenes.label: Custom
scenes.sub: Full access to native files. More control.
scenes.say: The bare workflow gives you full access to native code. Great for custom modules and deep integrations.
Expo is my pick for fast prototypes or simple apps. Bare is better when you need advanced native features.

scenes.question: Can you add any native module with Expo?
scenes.wrong: Yes, Expo supports all native modules.
scenes.right: No, Expo limits native modules. Use bare workflow for full native access.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Expo doesn't let you add just any native module. That's where the bare workflow shines.
